# UDGOK — Upscale Development Group

> AI-Powered Medical & Dental Design-Build Construction | Tulsa, Oklahoma

## About

Upscale Development Group (UDGOK) is a licensed Oklahoma general contractor specializing in healthcare and commercial Design-Build construction. Founded in 2015 and headquartered in Tulsa, Oklahoma, UDGOK has completed 100+ projects and delivers turnkey medical offices, dental clinics, oral surgery centers, eye clinics, and commercial facilities across Oklahoma and North Texas. UDGOK's Design-Build delivery model completes projects 30–40% faster than traditional design-bid-build. Average project budget ranges from $200K to $5M+.

## Why Choose UDGOK

- 100+ projects completed across Oklahoma and Texas
- Licensed Oklahoma General Contractor
- PMP-certified project managers on every project
- Design-Build model delivers 30–40% faster than traditional methods
- Specialized in healthcare construction: medical, dental, oral surgery, eye clinics
- NFPA 99 certified medical gas installation
- BIM/VDC technology for 3D clash detection and digital twin creation
- ADA, HIPAA, OSHA, and IBC code compliance expertise
- Serving Tulsa, Oklahoma City, Broken Arrow, Bixby, Jenks, Owasso, Dallas/Plano
